tools.label: CLI & Terminal UI
tools.summary: Work with your QQQ apps from a command line or an interactive terminal.
tools.note: Download the standalone binary for both CLI and TUI. The npm package includes only the CLI.
steps: Sign in to this instance using the command below. Follow the sign-in prompts on your computer.
Run qqq ui for the terminal app, or qqq --help for command-line options.

installOptions.instructions: With Scoop installed, run these commands in PowerShell. This installs the CLI and terminal UI together.
With Homebrew installed, run this command. It installs the CLI, terminal UI and shell completions.
No package manager required. Installs the CLI and terminal UI into ~/.local/bin and checks the release SHA-256 checksum. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH.
No package manager required. Installs into ~/.local/bin and checks the release SHA-256 checksum. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH. On Alpine, install libstdc++ and libgcc first.
If you already use Homebrew on Linux, this installs the CLI, terminal UI and shell completions.

tools.label: Mobile Scanners
tools.summary: Capture barcodes with an approved Android handheld and your QQQ scanning apps.
tools.note: Signed preview 1.0.0, not a stable release. Forge sign-in is required to download. Devices running a development-signed build need a planned migration; never uninstall or reset to bypass an installation refusal.
steps: Enter this instance's server address and sign in with your own QQQ account.
Enroll the device and ask an administrator to approve it. Open an available scanning app after approval.

installOptions.instructions: For a USB install, connect one handheld to this computer. On the handheld, open Settings > About phone, tap Build number seven times, then enable USB debugging in Developer options. Unlock it and accept the computer trust prompt. The script downloads Google's Platform Tools, opens the exact signed-preview release, verifies the downloaded APK and installs it. Forge login and APK download happen in your browser. Open PowerShell, paste the whole block and follow its prompts.

For a USB install, connect one handheld to this computer. On the handheld, open Settings > About phone, tap Build number seven times, then enable USB debugging in Developer options. Unlock it and accept the computer trust prompt. The script downloads Google's Platform Tools, opens the exact signed-preview release, verifies the downloaded APK and installs it. Forge login and APK download happen in your browser. Open Terminal and paste the whole block. Requires curl and unzip.

For a USB install, connect one handheld to this computer. On the handheld, open Settings > About phone, tap Build number seven times, then enable USB debugging in Developer options. Unlock it and accept the computer trust prompt. The script downloads Google's Platform Tools, opens the exact signed-preview release, verifies the downloaded APK and installs it. Forge login and APK download happen in your browser. Open a terminal and paste the whole block. Requires curl, unzip and USB access for your user; do not run adb as root.

Tap Get signed preview APK, sign in to the release site, and download QQQ-Mobile-1.0.0.apk. In the handheld's Files app, open Downloads and tap that file. If Android asks, allow this Files app to install apps, return and tap Install. Open QQQ Mobile and enter the HTTPS server address shown here. No computer or command line is needed for this method.

tools.label: Print Client
tools.summary: Connect this computer's printers to QQQ for documents and labels.
tools.note: Installation needs Windows administrator access. Only share printers intended for use with QQQ.
steps: Open QQQ Print Agent → Settings → Server connection. Enter this server address and sign in.
For a new device, ask a printing administrator for an enrollment code from Printing → Print devices → Enroll a print device.
Enter the code in the client, choose printers to share, then ask your administrator to enable the queues and run a test print.

installOptions.instructions: Open PowerShell on the Windows computer with your printers. Copy and run the entire block below. It downloads Print Client 1.0.1, verifies its checksum and publisher, opens the installer with an administrator prompt, then opens the setup app. Accept the installer prompts to continue.
